regressions.title: Capture export polish can now silently remove claims previously protected by verify blockquotes
regressions.evidence: New placed_text coverage at server.py:419 suppresses narrative verify blockquotes for placed claims. Only photo mode restores narration after polish. For capture narration 'Open console. Save settings.', polish can accept 'Open console.' under its 0.4 length-ratio and no-new-token checks. If narrative generation failed, narrative_text is None and verify_claims is empty. The final coverage check detects missing content but merely restores the same None narrative, leaving 'Save settings.' absent. Before this diff, narrative failure-independent successful coverage emitted a verify copy for omitted narrative claims.

regressions.title: Photo semantic-polish sidecar can report verify claims absent from the rendered document
regressions.evidence: Semantic rescue still runs polish_narration and collects dropped-clause verify_claims, but captioned steps now render raw pre-polish narration at line 568. The sidecar still includes the discarded polish result's verify IDs. Thus a clause retained verbatim in the document can be reported as requiring verification, while its corresponding nar-* verify marker is never rendered.
